name: alter-inline-fk
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child ALTER CONSTRAINT inline_fk DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

name: alter-fk
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child ALTER CONSTRAINT child_fk INITIALLY DEFERRED

name: deferrable-check
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child ALTER CONSTRAINT child_check DEFERRABLE

name: validate-check
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child VALIDATE CONSTRAINT pending_check

name: validate-fk
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child VALIDATE CONSTRAINT child_fk

name: validate-unique
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child VALIDATE CONSTRAINT child_unique

name: drop-with-cascade
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_parent DROP CONSTRAINT parent_pk CASCADE

name: conditional-drop
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS absent

name: missing-constraint
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child DROP CONSTRAINT absent

name: missing-table
sql: ALTER TABLE absent DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS child_check

name: conditional-table
sql: ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS absent VALIDATE CONSTRAINT child_check

name: multiple-commands
sql: ALTER TABLE constraint_child ALTER CONSTRAINT child_fk DEFERRABLE, VALIDATE CONSTRAINT pending_check, DROP CONSTRAINT child_unique
